intro: - 2025/06/01: 🌍 Over the past year, LivePortrait has 🚀 become an efficient portrait-animation (humans, cats and dogs) solution adopted by major video platforms—Kuaishou, Douyin, Jianying, WeChat Channels—as well as nu…
requirements: Firstly, check your current CUDA version by:
Animals mode is ONLY tested on Linux and Windows with NVIDIA GPU.

steps.title: 1. Clone the code and prepare the environment 🛠️
steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/KlingTeam/LivePortrait
cd LivePortrait

# create env using conda
conda create -n LivePortrait python=3.10
conda activate LivePortrait

steps.title: For Linux 🐧 or Windows 🪟 Users
steps.code:
nvcc -V # example versions: 11.1, 11.8, 12.1, etc.

# for CUDA 11.1
  pip install torch==1.10.1+cu111 torchvision==0.11.2 torchaudio==0.10.1 -f https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu111/torch_stable.html
  # for CUDA 11.8
  pip install torch==2.3.0 torchvision==0.18.0 torchaudio==2.3.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu118
  # for CUDA 12.1
  pip install torch==2.3.0 torchvision==0.18.0 torchaudio==2.3.0 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
  # ...

pip install -r requirements.txt

steps.title: For macOS  with Apple Silicon Users
steps.code:
# for macOS with Apple Silicon users
pip install -r requirements_macOS.txt

steps.title: 2. Download pretrained weights 📥
steps.code:
# !pip install -U "huggingface_hub[cli]"
huggingface-cli download KlingTeam/LivePortrait --local-dir pretrained_weights --exclude "*.git*" "README.md" "docs"

# !pip install -U "huggingface_hub[cli]"
export HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com
huggingface-cli download KlingTeam/LivePortrait --local-dir pretrained_weights --exclude "*.git*" "README.md" "docs"

steps.title: Fast hands-on (humans) 👤
steps.code:
# For Linux and Windows users
python inference.py

# For macOS users with Apple Silicon (Intel is not tested). NOTE: this maybe 20x slower than RTX 4090
PYTORCH_ENABLE_MPS_FALLBACK=1 python inference.py
